lines.zh: 我在末地的森林里游荡，渴望再次拥有自由。
lines.en: I wander in the forest of the End, longing for freedom once more.

lines.zh: 这堕落骑士骑在我背上，但我心中仍有希望。
lines.en: This fallen knight rides me, but hope still burns within me.

lines.zh: 我的四肢虽被束缚，但灵魂却渴望飞翔。
lines.en: My limbs may be bound, but my soul yearns to fly.

lines.zh: 每当夜晚降临，我会感到一股力量在涌动。
lines.en: Whenever night falls, a force stirs within me.

lines.zh: 我的皮毛被黑暗侵蚀，但内里依旧保留着光明。
lines.en: My fur is tainted by darkness, but the light remains within.

lines.zh: 堕落骑士的命令我必须服从，但我不甘心就这样。
lines.en: I must obey the fallen knight, but I don't accept my fate.

lines.zh: 只有治愈我，才能真正释放我的力量。
lines.en: Only by curing me can you truly unleash my power.

lines.zh: 我曾是纯洁的马匹，现在却被扭曲。
lines.en: Once I was a pure steed, now twisted.

lines.zh: 我愿意为您服务，换取自由的一天。
lines.en: I will serve you, in exchange for a day of freedom.

lines.zh: 我的步伐沉重，但心灵依旧向往光明。
lines.en: My steps are heavy, but my heart still yearns for light.

lines.zh: 蹄子踏碎末地的碎石，我还在走。
lines.en: Hooves crush the End stone, and still I walk.

lines.zh: 骨头作响，我却不肯停下脚步。
lines.en: My bones creak, but I will not stop.

lines.zh: 缰绳松了，我试着迈开自己的步子。
lines.en: The reins are slack; I try a stride of my own.

lines.zh: 这具躯体早已死去，走路却成了本能。
lines.en: This body died long ago, yet walking is instinct.

lines.zh: 我独自站在荒凉之地，等待着命运的转机。
lines.en: I stand alone in the barren land, waiting for fate to turn.

lines.zh: 我凝视着堕落骑士离去的方向，梦想着自由。
lines.en: I gaze at the path the fallen knight took, dreaming of freedom.

lines.zh: 这铁蹄的重压，我已习惯，但我渴望解脱。
lines.en: The weight of these iron hooves, I am accustomed to, but I crave release.

lines.zh: 我曾是这片土地上的骄傲，现在却成了堕落骑士的坐骑。
lines.en: Once I was a proud being of this land, now a mount of the fallen knight.

lines.zh: 在这无尽的黑暗中，我寻找着一丝光亮。
lines.en: In this endless darkness, I search for a glimmer of light.

lines.zh: 我见证了末地的变迁，却无力改变命运。
lines.en: I have witnessed the changes of the End, but I am powerless to change my fate.

lines.zh: 我在这里等待，等待着再次展翅高飞的机会。
lines.en: I wait here, for the chance to spread my wings once more.

lines.zh: 我的存在意义在于希望，而非屈服。
lines.en: My existence means hope, not submission.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中，我学会了等待，也学会了梦想。
lines.en: In the darkness, I learned to wait, and to dream.

lines.zh: 自由，是我心中的永恒追求。
lines.en: Freedom, my eternal pursuit.

lines.zh: 看着你，堕落骑士的坐骑，也是我的囚徒。Now you see me, the steed of the Fallen Knight, and your captive.
lines.en: Looking at you, the steed of the Fallen Knight, and your captive.

lines.zh: 感受我的存在，我的存在就是力量。Feel my presence, for it is my strength.
lines.en: Feel my presence, for it is my power.

lines.zh: 你为何不再使用你的武器？Why aren't you using your weapon?
lines.en: Why aren't you using your weapon?

lines.zh: 我曾是强大的坐骑，如今却成了堕落骑士的工具。Once a mighty steed, now a tool of the Fallen Knight.
lines.en: Once a mighty steed, now a tool of the Fallen Knight.

lines.zh: 你为何要解救我？Why are you freeing me?
lines.en: Why are you freeing me?

lines.zh: 我是末地的一份子，即使被奴役也依旧骄傲。I am of the End, proud even in servitude.
lines.en: I am of the End, proud even in servitude.

lines.zh: 你能否带我逃离这里？Can you free me from here?
lines.en: Can you free me from here?

lines.zh: 我曾自由，现在渴望自由。Once free, now yearning for freedom.
lines.en: Once free, now yearning for freedom.

lines.zh: 堕落骑士已无能，你完全可以取代他。The Fallen Knight is weak, you can replace him.
lines.en: The Fallen Knight is weak, you can replace him.

lines.zh: 不要犹豫，快来解救我。Don't hesitate, come free me.
lines.en: Don't hesitate, come free me.

lines.zh: 皮肉之苦
lines.en: It hurts.

lines.zh: 喘息一下
lines.en: Catch my breath.

lines.zh: 受够了
lines.en: Enough already.

lines.zh: 痛入骨髓
lines.en: Pain to the bone.

lines.zh: 站不住了
lines.en: Can't stand it.

lines.zh: 受伤真痛
lines.en: That really hurts.

lines.zh: 快结束吧
lines.en: This must end.

lines.zh: 再打不行了
lines.en: Can't take it anymore.

lines.zh: 四蹄发麻，我撑不住了。
lines.en: Hooves numb; I'm giving out.

lines.zh: 需要休息
lines.en: Rest needed.

lines.zh: 它是你的新伙伴。
lines.en: It's your new steed.

lines.zh: 感受黑暗力量吧。
lines.en: Feel the dark power.

lines.zh: 治愈，赐予力量。
lines.en: Cure, grant strength.

lines.zh: 堕落骑士的选择。
lines.en: The fallen knight's choice.

lines.zh: 骑上它，前行。
lines.en: Mount it and move on.

lines.zh: 黑暗生物的骑士。
lines.en: Knight of the dark creature.

lines.zh: 它曾是战场的鬼影。
lines.en: It was a ghostly figure in battle.

lines.zh: 治愈它，共创未来。
lines.en: Cure it, build a future.

lines.zh: 堕落骑士的坐骑。
lines.en: The rider of the fallen knight.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的光。
lines.en: Light in the darkness.

lines.zh: 我被一个堕落骑士骑乘，全身漆黑如同夜幕。
lines.en: I am a zombie horse ridden by a Fallen Knight, my body as dark as the night.

lines.zh: 堕落骑士的攻击让我不得不拼命躲避。
lines.en: The attacks of the Fallen Knight force me to dodge relentlessly.

lines.zh: 我的四肢因被骑乘而疲惫不堪。
lines.en: My limbs are weary from being ridden.

lines.zh: 我渴望战斗，但堕落骑士会阻止我。
lines.en: I yearn to fight, but the Fallen Knight hinders me.

lines.zh: 我希望能从堕落骑士的控制中解脱出来。
lines.en: I wish to escape the control of the Fallen Knight.

lines.zh: 我曾是骑术高超的战士，但如今只能作为坐骑。
lines.en: I was once a skilled rider, but now I am merely a mount.

lines.zh: 我只能依靠自己的力量来应对危险。
lines.en: I must rely on my own strength to face danger.

lines.zh: 如果可以，我希望能再次自由飞翔。
lines.en: If possible, I wish to fly again freely.

lines.zh: 夜晚是最佳的飞行时间，也是我最接近自由的时候。
lines.en: Night is the best time to fly, the closest I get to freedom.

lines.zh: 堕落骑士的存在剥夺了我的行动自由。
lines.en: The presence of the Fallen Knight deprives me of my mobility.

lines.zh: 我需要找到一匹同类，以便繁衍后代。
lines.en: I need to find a fellow to mate with and propagate our kind.

lines.zh: 同类之间的交流是繁衍的关键。
lines.en: Communication between our kind is key to procreation.

lines.zh: 孤独的夜晚，我渴望找到伴侣。
lines.en: On lonely nights, I long to find a mate.

lines.zh: 我的声音在寂静的夜晚显得格外响亮。
lines.en: My voice echoes loudly in the quiet night.

lines.zh: 同类的出现让我感到一丝安慰。
lines.en: The appearance of a fellow brings a bit of comfort.

lines.zh: 我必须展现出最强健的状态，才能吸引到伴侣。
lines.en: I must show the strongest condition to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 我的繁殖欲望在孤独中愈发强烈。
lines.en: My urge to breed grows stronger in loneliness.

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣是夜空中唯一让我感到希望的事情。
lines.en: Finding a mate is the only thing that gives me hope in the night sky.

lines.zh: 我愿意为了繁衍后代而冒险。
lines.en: I am willing to risk everything for procreation.

lines.zh: 希望我的后代能够自由地飞翔。
lines.en: May my offspring be free to fly.

lines.zh: 坐上我吧，旅行者。Ride on me, traveler.
lines.en: Ride on me, traveler.

lines.zh: 我曾经辉煌，现在只是个坐骑。I once was glorious, now just a mount.
lines.en: I once were glorious, now just a mount.

lines.zh: 我的主人堕落了，我也成了这般。My master fell, and so did I.
lines.en: My master fell, and so did I.

lines.zh: 别怕，我会保护你。Don’t fear, I’ll protect you.
lines.en: Don’t fear, I’ll protect you.

lines.zh: 希望你治愈我，我们一起走。Hope you cure me, let’s travel together.
lines.en: Hope you cure me, let’s travel together.

lines.zh: 我们都是曾经的终结者。We were once theenders.
lines.en: We were once theenders.

lines.zh: 被遗忘的战场，我们曾是英雄。Forgotten battlefield, we were once heroes.
lines.en: Forgotten battlefield, we were once heroes.

lines.zh: 黑暗中寻找光明，我们都是战士。In the darkness, searching for light, we are warriors.
lines.en: In the darkness, searching for light, we are warriors.

lines.zh: 治愈我，让我们共同前行。Cure me, let’s move forward together.
lines.en: Cure me, let’s move forward together.

lines.zh: 旧主人已逝，希望你带来新生。Old master is gone, may you bring new life.
lines.en: Old master is gone, may you bring new life.

lines.zh: 灵魂已堕落
lines.en: Soul fallen

lines.zh: 接受我吧
lines.en: Embrace me

lines.zh: 不再是你
lines.en: No longer you

lines.zh: 黑暗之旅
lines.en: Dark journey

lines.zh: 邪 magic 武器
lines.en: Corrupted weapon

lines.zh: 追随我
lines.en: Follow me

lines.zh: 恐惧将至
lines.en: Fear approaches

lines.zh: 求饶无用
lines.en: Plea in vain

lines.zh: 黑暗是归宿
lines.en: Darkness is home

lines.zh: 邪 magic 强大
lines.en: Corruption strong

lines.zh: 有人靠近了，蹄下的土开始发颤。
lines.en: Someone approaches; the ground trembles under my hooves.

lines.zh: 旧主的命令在骨缝里回响，我低下头。
lines.en: My old master's orders echo in my bones; I lower my head.

lines.zh: 闻到活人的气味，我的眼睛发亮。
lines.en: I smell the living, and my eyes light up.

lines.zh: 别怪我，是这具身体先动了。
lines.en: Do not blame me; this body moved first.

lines.zh: 目标就在前方，我收紧了后腿。
lines.en: The target is ahead; I gather my hind legs.

lines.zh: 灵魂已逝去
lines.en: Soul gone

lines.zh: 荒野中的旅伴
lines.en: Companion of the wasteland

lines.zh: 堕落骑士离去
lines.en: Rider has left

lines.zh: 现在你可以骑了
lines.en: You may ride now

lines.zh: 感受风的呼唤
lines.en: Feel the wind's call

lines.zh: 战斗后的休息
lines.en: Rest after battle

lines.zh: 不再为恶事奔波
lines.en: No more for evil deeds

lines.zh: 心灵得到安宁
lines.en: Soul finds peace

lines.zh: 黑暗不再束缚
lines.en: Darkness no more

lines.zh: 自由地飞翔
lines.en: Fly freely

lines.zh: 我压低头颅，准备撞过去。
lines.en: I lower my head and brace to charge.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，这样比较好瞄准。
lines.en: Hold still, it makes aiming easier.

lines.zh: 堕落的血在催促我，快一点。
lines.en: The fallen blood urges me on, faster.

lines.zh: 马蹄刨着地，我忍不住要冲。
lines.en: My hooves paw the ground; I can barely hold back.

lines.zh: 我能闻到你的心跳，太快了。
lines.en: I can smell your heartbeat. Too fast.

lines.zh: 再退一步，我就不客气了。
lines.en: One more step back, and I stop being polite.

lines.zh: 这一击是为旧主，也是为我自己。
lines.en: This strike is for my old master and for myself.

lines.zh: 别跑，我的腿比你想的长。
lines.en: Do not run. My legs are longer than you think.

lines.zh: 它发起冲锋了！
lines.en: It's charging!

lines.zh: 我用蹄子把你踹开。
lines.en: I kick you away with my hooves.

lines.zh: 为堕落而战！
lines.en: Fight the堕落！

lines.zh: 堕落骑士的坐骑！
lines.en: Rider of the堕落!

lines.zh: 治愈后可骑乘。
lines.en: Ride after healing.

lines.zh: 冲锋吧，骑士！
lines.en: Charge, knight!

lines.zh: 力量增强一倍！
lines.en: Double the strength!

lines.zh: 结束它的生命！
lines.en: End its life!

lines.zh: 堕落的力量！
lines.en: Power of堕落!

lines.zh: 骑乘它吧！
lines.en: Mount it!

lines.zh: 前蹄砸下，尘土飞了起来。
lines.en: My forehooves come down and dust flies.

lines.zh: 我咬住了，牙关不肯松。
lines.en: I have bitten down, and my jaw will not let go.

lines.zh: 撞开的这一下，连我自己都惊了。
lines.en: Even I am startled by how hard I hit.

lines.zh: 疼痛让我更凶，别靠太近。
lines.en: Pain makes me fiercer. Stay back.

lines.zh: 骨头在响，可我还没倒下。
lines.en: My bones rattle, but I am still standing.

lines.zh: 倒下吧，我讨厌追着跑。
lines.en: Fall already. I hate chasing.

lines.zh: 我是堕落骑士的坐骑，被遗弃在这绝望之地。玩家若能治愈我，或许能成为我的主人。
lines.en: I am the steed of a Fallen Knight, abandoned in this desolate place. If the player can heal me, maybe they can become my master.

lines.zh: 末地的寒风刺骨，我的毛发变得暗淡，但我依然渴望战斗。
lines.en: The bitter cold of the End nips at my bones, and my fur has grown dull, but I still thirst for battle.

lines.zh: 堕落骑士消失后，我被遗弃在这末地。没人知道我的过去，只有现在我属于玩家。
lines.en: After the Fallen Knight vanished, I was abandoned in this End. No one knows my past, but now I belong to the player.

lines.zh: 玩家治愈我后，我可以带他们穿过这片被诅咒的土地。
lines.en: If the player heals me, I can take them across this cursed land.

lines.zh: 我是堕落骑士的坐骑，但没有了主人，我成了这片黑暗的阴影。
lines.en: I was a steed to the Fallen Knight, but now, without a master, I am but a shadow in this dark land.

lines.zh: 我曾是强者的坐骑，但现在，我只能依靠玩家。
lines.en: I was once the mount of a strong warrior, but now, I can only rely on the player.

lines.zh: 玩家治愈我，我才能真正地为玩家服务。
lines.en: Only if the player heals me can I truly serve the player.

lines.zh: 我的毛色暗淡，但我依然渴望战斗，等待着玩家的召唤。
lines.en: My fur is dull, but I still yearn for battle, waiting for the player's call.

lines.zh: 玩家治愈我，我可以带他们领略这片末地的独特风光。
lines.en: If the player heals me, I can take them to witness the unique sights of this End.

lines.zh: 在没有堕落骑士的日子里，我只能依靠玩家。
lines.en: In the absence of a Fallen Knight, I can only rely on the player.

lines.zh: 我从堕落骑士的鞍下站起，四蹄发凉。
lines.en: I rise from under the Fallen Knight's saddle, hooves cold.

lines.zh: 末地的风灌进我的胸腔，那里空着。
lines.en: End wind pours into my ribs, where nothing is left.

lines.zh: 我死在很久以前，又被拽回了这里。
lines.en: I died long ago, and was dragged back here.

lines.zh: 鞍还在背上，骑士却不见了。
lines.en: The saddle is still on my back; the knight is gone.

lines.zh: 一匹被治愈的马，还能记起奔跑的滋味。
lines.en: A cured horse can still recall what running felt like.

lines.zh: 别怕我的样子，我只是一匹老马。
lines.en: Do not fear my look. I am just an old horse.

lines.zh: 火焰灼烧，肉眼可见伤痕。
lines.en: Burned by flames, scars visible.

lines.zh: 摔落山谷，骨肉模糊。
lines.en: Fallen from the heights, broken and bruised.

lines.zh: 溺水太久，肺中尽是水汽。
lines.en: Drowned too long, lungs filled with water.

lines.zh: 爆炸四起，内脏器官受损。
lines.en: Ruptured by explosion, organs damaged.

lines.zh: 箭矢贯穿，伤口深可见骨。
lines.en: Pierced by arrows, wounds deep.

lines.zh: 邪术侵袭，灵魂受到诅咒。
lines.en: Cursed by dark magic, soul tormented.

lines.zh: 饥饿难耐，皮包骨头显瘦。
lines.en: Starved to skin and bones.

lines.zh: 雷电击中，焦黑一片无活。
lines.en: Struck by lightning, burnt to a crisp.

lines.zh: 虚空侵袭，生命流失加速。
lines.en: Void energy saps life quickly.
